run.name: QQQ Defensive regime allocator, out-of-sample walk-forward public record
run.evaluation: hourly bars during regular trading hours; first and last bar of each session skipped for order generation
run.instruments_note: ETFs only. No options, no shorting, no margin. Quotes are real hourly bars from Interactive Brokers market data, not model prices.
run.walk_forward: 11 folds, about 1.5 years of training then 6 months of out-of-sample test, stepped every 6 months; test windows concatenate into one continuous curve
